text_pointers.first_1500_characters:
ALASKA

By virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by the act of March 12, 1914, c. 37, 38 Stat. 305, and the act of June 25, 1910, c. 421, 36 Stat. 847, as amended by the act of August 24, 1912, c. 369, 37 Stat. 497, it is ordered as follows:

Section 1. Executive Order No. 2224 of July 19, 1915, withdrawing and reserving certain lands in Alaska for townsite purposes, is hereby modified to the extent necessary to permit the following-described townsite lots to be used by the Bureau of Public Roads, Department of Agriculture, in connection with road building projects, and such lands are hereby reserved and set apart for such use:

FEDERAL ADDITION TO SEWARD TOWNSITE

Block 12, Lots 4, 5, and 6

Section 2. This order shall remain in force until revoked by the President or by act of Congress.

FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT

The White House,

April 15, 1939.
